paper_id: CAI_ Caption-Sensitive Attention Intervention for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
title: CAI: Caption-Sensitive Attention Intervention for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
motivation: 现有方法要么需要昂贵的标注/训练成本,要么显著增加推理延迟,需要一种低成本、无训练的幻觉缓解方法
problem_framing: 将幻觉问题重新定义为注意力机制缺陷：LVLM对视觉token的注意力不足导致生成与视觉信息冲突的内容
key_insight: LVLM在回答caption查询时对视觉信息的注意力显著强于非caption查询,可识别并精细化caption-sensitive attention heads来增强视觉感知
method_signature: 训练-free方法,通过SVM二分类器识别caption-sensitive heads,在推理时应用预计算的注意力输出位移向量进行干预
evaluation_criteria: POPE准确率/F1、MME感知分数、CHAIR句子/实例级幻觉率、MMHal-Bench信息丰富度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: CAI依赖合适的caption查询可用性;不适用于不依赖multi-head attention的LVLM
evidence_for_taste: does not rely on specific models or data
balance between enhancing visual perception and maintaining the integrity of other foundational capabilities
thinking_moves: 通过观察不同查询类型下注意力权重的差异,将perception问题转化为attention mechanism探测问题
把caption query作为激活模型视觉感知能力的触发器,而非简单的数据增强
用二分类器Probe而非手工定义来识别关键attention heads
承认方法的适用范围依赖特定架构前提
